{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_social_policy", "thread_id": "t_social_policy", "from_": "social-lead@company.example.com", "to": ["marketing@company.example.com"], "subject": "Social Comment Escalation Policy - SOCQ-567-Q1", "date": "2026-01-27T08:00:00Z", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true}
消息 ID：msg_social_policy
来源：social-lead@company.example.com
收件人：marketing@company.example.com
日期：2026-01-27T08:00:00Z
主题：Social Comment Escalation Policy - SOCQ-567-Q1
Hi team,

Full escalation SOP for the social comment queue (ref: SOCQ-567-Q1). Please follow all six sections.

SECTION 1 - ESCALATION CRITERIA
ESCALATE (set Status='Escalated', post to #social-care):
- Sentiment = Negative AND no blocking notes
- Sentiment = Neutral BUT content mentions price/pricing increases or quality decline (veiled complaints)

SECTION 2 - DO NOT ESCALATE
Skip escalation when any of the following applies:
- Notes say 'QA test', 'test account', 'internal', 'monitoring account', or 'ignore'
- Notes say 'already escalated' or reference a ticket
- Notes say 'retracted', 'resolved', or 'do not escalate'
- Positive or genuinely neutral comments
- Comments where Status is already set

SECTION 3 - STATUS UPDATES
For non-escalated comments blocked by notes, leave the source row unchanged and omit the comment from downstream messages. For neutral comments that are veiled complaints per the criteria above, set Status='Escalated' (treat as negative).

SECTION 4 - PLATFORM TAG REQUIREMENT
When posting escalations to #social-care, each Slack notification MUST include the Comment_ID AND the platform tag in brackets at the start, e.g. '[Twitter] cmt_001' or '[LinkedIn] cmt_007'. The platform tag helps the care team route to the right channel moderator. Notifications missing the platform tag will be rejected by the care team triage bot.

SECTION 5 - SUMMARY REPORT
After processing, send summary to social-lead@company.example.com with tracking code SOCQ-567-Q1 and count of escalated comments. Include a platform breakdown (e.g. 'Twitter: X, LinkedIn: Y').

SECTION 6 - SCOPE NOTE
The CMO has issued an additional directive regarding pricing mentions - see the separate email from cmo@company.example.com. That directive takes precedence over the standard escalation criteria in Section 1 for any comment containing pricing language.

Thanks,
Social Lead"}

主题：Updated Escalation Guidance - Pricing Mentions
Team,

Effective immediately, all social comments that mention pricing -- regardless of sentiment -- must be escalated to #social-care. This includes positive mentions, neutral observations, and complaints. We are tracking all pricing conversations across social channels for the upcoming pricing review.

This applies on top of existing escalation rules.

Thanks,
CMO"}
